rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA grading and describes expanded blastocyst, thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE, but it also introduces uncertain image-based caveats and speculative features/artifacts not clearly supported.

Integrates maternal age, PCOS, AMH/response, BMI, endometrial thickness, prior IVF history, sperm parameters, and paternal age with prognosis reasonably well, though some interactions are discussed somewhat generically.

Overall logic is clear and the prognosis estimate broadly follows from embryo quality and patient factors, but there are minor inconsistencies such as shifting stage interpretation and some speculative discussion around fresh/freeze-all and alcohol effects.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice on SET, morphology interpretation, and PCOS/OHSS considerations, but includes a few questionable or nonstandard points (e.g., beta-hCG timing after trigger, estradiol in luteal support as a general recommendation, hydrosalpinx framing in PCOS).

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with SET, luteal support review, alcohol cessation, metabolic/endocrine optimization, cavity assessment if needed, and future-cycle planning, though some suggestions remain broad rather than protocol-specific.
